nvitk.measure.morpho.geometry¶

Generic geometry, arc-length, tangent, resampling, and polyline helpers.

Functions¶

unit_vector(→ Optional[numpy.ndarray])

Normalize v to unit length; None if it is (near) zero.

point_inside_mask_mm(→ bool)

True when world point pt_mm falls on a foreground voxel of mask_bool.

sample_edt_mm(→ float)

Nearest-voxel lookup of a precomputed distance-transform volume at world point pt_mm.

estimate_path_endpoint_tangent(path_mm[, at_start, n_pts])

Outward-pointing unit tangent at a path endpoint, averaged over its first/last n_pts points.

march_endpoint_to_wall(start_pt_mm, tangent_out, ...)

Step outward from start_pt_mm along tangent_out until near the mask wall or leaving the mask.

extend_path_to_walls(path_mm, mask_bool, spacing[, ...])

Extend both ends of a centerline path outward to the mask wall (march_endpoint_to_wall()).

arc_length(→ float)

Total polyline length (sum of consecutive-point distances); NaN for <2 points.

resample_polyline_by_arclength(→ numpy.ndarray)

Resample a polyline to near-equal arc-length steps of step_mm via binary-search chord fitting.

resample_generated_centerline_points(→ numpy.ndarray)

Apply the configured arc-length resampling (resample_polyline_by_arclength()) if enabled.

chord_length(→ float)

Straight-line distance from the first to the last point; NaN for <2 points.

cumulative_s(→ numpy.ndarray)

Cumulative arc length at each point along the polyline, starting at 0.

point_at_arc_length(→ numpy.ndarray)

Linearly interpolate the polyline point at arc-length target_s (clamped to the path extent).

trimmed_seed_pair_from_path(...)

New (start, end) seed points trimmed inward from the path ends by the given mm amounts.

mean_distance_to_polyline_points(→ float)

Mean nearest-neighbor distance from each of query_pts to the point set ref_pts (KD-tree).

trim_polyline_overlap_with_reference_ends(...)

Trim leading/trailing points of a donut-loop arm that overlap the main reference centerline(s).

splice_skeleton_end_connectors(→ numpy.ndarray)

Reconnect a trimmed path's ends to the nearest points on the raw skeleton arm when the gap exceeds blend_mm.

trim_polyline_ends_by_length(→ numpy.ndarray)

Trim a fixed arc-length amount off each end of a polyline (no-op if that would remove ≥80% of it).

contiguous_true_runs(→ List[Tuple[int, int]])

List of [start, stop) index ranges covering each contiguous run of True in mask.

Total polyline length (sum of consecutive-point distances); NaN for <2 points.

nvitk.measure.morpho.geometry.resample_polyline_by_arclength(pts_mm: numpy.ndarray, step_mm: float | None) → numpy.ndarray¶

Resample a polyline to near-equal arc-length steps of step_mm via binary-search chord fitting.

Drops NaN/duplicate-adjacent points first, then walks the path picking points at (approximately) constant chord length, adjusting the chord by bisection so the last segment isn’t badly under/oversized.

nvitk.measure.morpho.geometry.resample_generated_centerline_points(pts_mm: numpy.ndarray) → numpy.ndarray¶

Apply the configured arc-length resampling (resample_polyline_by_arclength()) if enabled.

Cumulative arc length at each point along the polyline, starting at 0.

New (start, end) seed points trimmed inward from the path ends by the given mm amounts.

None if the remaining span would be shorter than the minimum retry separation.

nvitk.measure.morpho.geometry.mean_distance_to_polyline_points(query_pts: numpy.ndarray, ref_pts: numpy.ndarray) → float¶

Mean nearest-neighbor distance from each of query_pts to the point set ref_pts (KD-tree).

nvitk.measure.morpho.geometry.trim_polyline_overlap_with_reference_ends(pts: numpy.ndarray, reference_centerline_points: List[numpy.ndarray] | None, spacing, min_points_after_trim: int | None = None, keep_original_if_too_short: bool = True) → Tuple[numpy.ndarray, int, int, int, float]¶

Trim leading/trailing points of a donut-loop arm that overlap the main reference centerline(s).

Returns (trimmed_points, n_trimmed_start, n_trimmed_end, n_kept, overlap_tol_mm). If the trim would leave fewer than min_points_after_trim points, keeps the original path (or empties it) per keep_original_if_too_short.

Reconnect a trimmed path’s ends to the nearest points on the raw skeleton arm when the gap exceeds blend_mm.

Trim a fixed arc-length amount off each end of a polyline (no-op if that would remove ≥80% of it).
